title: Opening of the Steve Angrum interview, 8 August 1961
summary: The interviewer states the date and place, at Angrum's home on Allen Street, and takes his full name.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: I'll start out by saying this is an interview with Mr. Steve Angram and the date is August the 8th, 1961. We're out at his home at 2105 Allen Street. Do you want to give your full name Mr. Angram? Stephen Angram. Any middle name? No, no middle name.
